note: System tab of the command list (game/ui/command_list/netsu_command_list.gd). One page per entry of pages; topics are rows, {"heading": "..."} starts a group. preview: {"move": "<engine move name>"} or {"state": "<state name>"} plays it with the fighter shown (the player's own in a match), {"illustration": "gauge|scaling|levels|overdrive|juggle"} draws an example, {"cutin": "ex|super"} shows the fighter's cut-in art. data: up to six [label, value] cells. Numbers here are text: update them when the rules change (docs/game_systems.md).

topics.name: Dash · Air Dash
topics.desc: Double-tap to dash or back dash; in the air it's an air dash. The forward air dash is a low hop that bumps into standing opponents but clears crouching ones. The back air dash is a stall.

topics.name: Jumping
topics.desc: You can't block for the first 10 frames of a jump, so jumping out of pressure is a read, not a free escape.

topics.name: Chains & Reverse Beat
topics.desc: Normals chain from light to heavy. A normal that hit or was blocked can also chain into a lighter one, each normal once per chain.

topics.name: Universal Launcher
topics.desc: Every ground normal cancels into 6C on hit or block. On hit, jump (8) to chase into an air combo.

topics.name: Throw
topics.desc: Close range. 4 + B+C throws behind you. A throw that connects can cancel into an EX move or a super. The answer to blocking.

topics.name: EX Moves
topics.desc: C on a special spends 1 bar for its EX version: invincible, or a bigger launch or bounce. Without the bar it comes out as the B version.

topics.name: Supers (S-Crafts)
topics.desc: A motion plus B+C spends 3 bars. The fight stops for the cut-in, and the super cancels all your momentum as it starts.

topics.name: Special › EX Cancel
topics.desc: Any special that hit or was blocked cancels into an EX move.

topics.name: Damage Scaling
topics.desc: From the 2nd hit everything does 72%, and every hit lowers the hits after it. Using the same move again costs more. EX moves and supers keep a minimum damage.

topics.name: Juggle Decay & OTG
topics.desc: The longer a combo runs, the less untech time each hit gives; when it runs out they always air tech. A downed opponent can only be hit for a short OTG window.

topics.name: Counter Hits
topics.desc: Hitting a move during its startup or recovery adds 12 frames of hitstun, so slow moves combo on counter hit.

topics.name: Attack Levels
topics.desc: Hold back to block; crouch to block lows, stand to block overheads. Every attack has a level that sets how long you're stuck blocking it.

topics.name: Pushblock
topics.desc: While blocking: stay in block and push the attacker about 1.6 m away. In the corner you slide back instead. It doesn't end blockstun.

topics.name: Throw Tech
topics.desc: Press B+C within 10 frames of being grabbed to break it. Nobody takes damage.

topics.name: Burst
topics.desc: Only while being hit. Uses the whole Burst gauge and knocks them away. It refills slowly: plan on about one per round.

topics.name: Craft Gauge
topics.desc: Kept between rounds. Landing hits fills it most; getting hit or blocking fills it less; whiffs give nothing. After spending, gains drop to a quarter for 3 seconds. Below 35% health it slowly fills by itself.

topics.name: Overdrive
topics.desc: Turns on by itself once per round at 30% health or lower, and lasts until the round ends.

topics.name: Assist Calls
topics.desc: In neutral the call is free, but your fighter poses and can't block. During a normal or special that hit or was blocked it's an Assist Cancel for 1 bar. Not in the air, while blocking or out of an EX move, super or throw.
